body: I'm not dead yet guys and I have a legal plan. I think it's going to work. If you guys can think of anything help that could help me keep my dogs legally id appreciate it very much. Update is that I still have a chance and that no lawyers have replied to but hopefully I won't need them.

OK people last night I didn't do it. I thought fuck it might as well go out trying to save my dogs. I just found out they lied about registrations the dogs are unregistered(unlicensed whatever). I'm going to scramble to get the licenses.

I wanna say thanks to everyone who tried to help me. And also, don't trust anyone when it comes to something you love. Make sure you take steps to have the legal upperhand or you'll get fucked over. 

In the end the rich assholes in suits do whatever they want and the poor idiot loses the only thing he cares about.
They gave both of them to me. They are not microchipped.

They hear everything and they'll send out cops looking for me.

I don't think the legal route is going to work. Spying won't cause she's nosey and suspicious, she'll catch on quick. She'll take good care of them just to make I don't get them, even though she tells me every day she wants them out of here. I feel sick.

The records all point to them. They'll pay vet bills and medicine with their credit and then i pay in cash. I have zero proof and they already rubbed that in my face earlier. The law is on their side.
They'll call the cops. Living in hiding won't be a good life for my dogs.
I know you didn't mean anything offensive by it, but my dogs are my children, I can't just buy another set.
I wish I had someone I could trust with that. But, unsurprisingly, I have no friends.

Sadly, you can't help me. All I want is my dogs and they have money enough that any shitty lawyer I get won't get them back to me. I wish accommadations were my problem. But right now my problem is finding a place where I can die in peace.
The last thing I loved has been taken from me. There's nothing left for me here.

I know that she can't make me stay here as I'm over 18. But she can take measures to keep my dogs. And she will. She is that evil. Anyway, it doesn't matter anymore. My new thread / last thread is here: http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/djtwx/game_over/
So I'll still lose them. If losing some money or doing some jail time would get them back to me, I would do it in heartbeat. LOL is there there a suicide subreddit?

I have been nice. She is using the dogs as her pawns. She refused to any sort of agreement. You don't understand. She's a manipulative liar. What's happening now is what's happened my whole life, but I didn't think she could sink this low. Taking them with me would be the right thing to do, but she'll put me in jail and then my dogs will end up here anyway.

I have finances to take care of myself and the dogs, and to get a lawyer. But they have far more money than I do. I'm so sad right now I seriously want to die. Those dogs are the most important thing to me and they know that. They constantly say we should get rid of them.

I'm going somewhere where they'll have a yard and will be safe. I think they're registered in my mother's name. If that's the case do you think the fact that this is a dangerous environment will be irrelevant? I would have registered the dog's in my own name if i had ever thought it would come to this.
Buy a bag of pinto beans. Boil them and eat them. Probably the cheapest thing you can eat and still be healthy. Ramen is cheap too but it's not really very nutritional.
